purpose: Define explicit challenge creation when an otherwise potentially authorized operation lacks sufficiently fresh assurance.

topics.name: Reauthentication Challenge
topics.purpose: Define explicit challenge creation when an otherwise potentially authorized operation lacks sufficiently fresh assurance.

semantics.identity_rule: Each challenge has an explicit challenge identity.
semantics.request_rule: Challenge references exact original operation request/target.
semantics.inert_rule: Pending challenge creates no operation effect.
semantics.resume_rule: Satisfied challenge resumes through fresh authorization/dispatch validation as required.
semantics.secret_rule: Challenge evidence excludes raw authentication factors.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.

references.purpose: Challenge satisfies an exact reauth requirement.
